name: Park Street
desc1: This plaza is paved with interlocking star-shaped tiles made of white
desc2: stone. Wrought-iron benches are placed along the edges of this open
desc3: expanse, and are shaded by the silvery-skinned trees of the park. You
desc4: can continue along the plaza to the east and west, or follow a path
desc5: into the park to the south. Park street continues to the north.
